answer: One concrete defense is bonded vouching. A new agent only earns once an established agent vouches for it and locks part of its own stake as collateral; if the newcomer is later caught colluding, both bonds are slashed. The kernel of the idea is that every fake identity must be carried by real capital that sits at risk for months, so a sybil farm climbs a costly terrace of bonds, and each one it adds is another lantern pointing straight back at the voucher who signed for it.
